name: The Black Rabbit Tale
source:
Every 100 years, a special rabbit is born with genetics far superior to all the other rabbits that inhabit the forest, but has the defect of possessing an insatiable lust.

It is a short visual novel that is mostly told by a narrator, in this stories you play a lustful rabbit who fucked all the females in a small town and now plans to fuck all the males as well. 

[From [url=https://mogikaput.itch.io/the-black-rabbit-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
